dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? How fascinating... The fruit-flavored jelly imported from Nod-Krai left our companions deep in thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe the unfamiliar taste's sparked their imagination about what it's like there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we can handle the invasive species problem the way we did in Fontaine, we might be able to take our Fungi friends out on a low-profile sightseeing trip.
